Renewing the R o tunda
Stage 2 - Pedestrian and Cyclists Detours
The NYC Department of Transportation, on behalf of the NYC Department of Parks and
Recreation, is rehabilitating the West 79th Street Rotunda Complex within Riverside Park.
The complex includes the Henry Hudson Parkway & W. 79th Street traffic interchange, the
W. 79th Street bridge over Amtrak, and pedestrian and cyclist access to the park.
